title: Account with [Full Access]
description: Security rule — accounts assigned the [Full Access] privilege set. Every full-access account is an unrestricted key to the file; keep the count minimal.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Full-access accounts bypass all record- and layout-level security.
rule.remediation: Grant the least privilege needed; reserve [Full Access] for a few named admins.
